about: Prompts for new Walk for Education campaign scenes generated through the Zapier ChatGPT (OpenAI) 'Create Image Edit' action, model gpt-image-1.5. The action accepts ONE source image, so reference-sheet-shyaka-kit.jpg combines the real face portrait (left), real black shirt (centre) and real black backpack (right). Candidates are in ./candidates and are NOT integrated into the site; review per handoff/claude/guides/06_IMAGE_ART_DIRECTION_GUIDE.md before accepting.
preamble: The input is a three-panel REFERENCE SHEET, not a layout to copy. LEFT panel = identity lock: the real man, Rtn. Shyaka Mbanda, dark skin, black fabric headwrap, full thick black beard with grey flecks at the chin, shoulder-length locs at the sides of his face. CENTRE panel = wardrobe lock: his black short-sleeved cotton Walk for Education T-shirt; keep the printed front arrangement: top row PCI logo, Rotary Club of Akright City, UCU crest; then the white walking-figure icon with yellow swoosh, WALK FOR EDUCATION, the line Nairobi to Kagando, 1,300 km | 1,650,000 Steps, and a yellow rectangle BUY A STEP BUILD A FUTURE. RIGHT panel = bag lock: his black multi-compartment backpack with zip pockets, front print of red PCI logo, Rotary wheel, UCU crest, walking-figure icon, yellow BUY A STEP BUILD A FUTURE banner, small Uganda flag patch, two silver eyelets at the base. The Uganda flag patch belongs to the BAG only, never the shirt. Invent no extra badges, logos or mirrored writing. Output ONE new photograph of ONLY the scene below: no panels, no grey borders, no collage, no captions.

scenes.scene: Premium photorealistic documentary campaign photograph, 85 mm telephoto lens at hip height, shallow depth of field, blue hour turning to first light on a quiet East African road. Shyaka is seen from behind in rear three-quarter view, walking away from camera along the edge of a quiet paved road, head turned a few degrees so a sliver of beard profile and the headwrap catch warm amber rim light from the low sun ahead. The black backpack is naturally carried with real strap tension over both shoulders and its printed outer face is fully visible and sharp. He wears the black campaign T-shirt, dark practical trousers and sturdy dark walking shoes. Natural adult proportions and a convincing gait; head in correct proportion to shoulders and torso. Background: low mist over fields, soft tree silhouettes, a thin band of warm sky; the road leads diagonally into the distance. Shyaka in the right third; the left half is calm soft sky and mist with very low detail, reserved for a website headline. Cool blue shadows, warm amber highlights, real contact shadows, no HDR, no beauty smoothing. No signs, road names, text overlays, finish banners, watermarks or UI.

scenes.status: NOT generated: Zapier call timed out at 60 s, no image returned. Re-run with results_number 1.
scenes.scene: Premium photorealistic high-angle aerial drone photograph, about 70 metres up looking down at roughly 60 degrees, golden afternoon light. A red-earth murram road makes a graceful S-curve through green East African hillside farmland: banana groves, patchwork gardens, terraced tea rows, scattered eucalyptus. One lone walker, Shyaka, small in frame (about 7 percent of the image height) in mid-stride on the road, seen from above and slightly behind: black T-shirt, black backpack with its small yellow BUY A STEP banner as a tiny bright accent, dark trousers, a long soft shadow along the road beside him. Correct small-figure anatomy: head about one-seventh of body height, natural stride. The road leads the eye from lower-left toward the upper-right horizon with soft haze and distant blue hills. Keep the upper-left third calm, low-detail green hillside and haze, reserved for a website headline. Natural colour, no HDR. No signs, road names, vehicles with readable plates, route lines, labels, watermark or UI.

Premium photorealistic documentary campaign photograph, 35 mm lens at eye level, f/2, blue dusk just after rain on a quiet East African town-edge road. Shyaka walks toward the camera in a three-quarter view, mid-stride, calm and determined, looking slightly past the lens; fine drizzle hangs in the air and a few drops glisten on his beard, locs and headwrap. His black campaign T-shirt is slightly darkened by rain and its printed front is visible but gently soft. Both black backpack straps are visible over his shoulders. Dark practical trousers, sturdy dark walking shoes. Full figure from head to shoes occupies about two thirds of the frame height on the right third; soft reflection of warm out-of-focus street lights on the wet tarmac. Natural adult proportions: head correctly sized to the shoulders and torso, real hands. The left half is quiet blue-charcoal bokeh with very low detail, reserved for a website headline. Cool blue shadows, a few warm amber highlights, real skin texture, no beauty smoothing, no HDR, no heavy vignette. No umbrella, rain jacket, signs, readable shop names, road names, watermark or UI text.

Premium photorealistic editorial detail photograph of the official kit being worn on the road, 100 mm lens at f/2.8, warm low side light, very shallow depth of field. Crop from just below his nose down to mid-chest, slight side-front angle so only the lower beard and jaw edge appear at the top of the frame. A black padded backpack strap pulls across his shoulder and collarbone with real fabric tension and tiny stitching detail; his right hand hooks the strap near the chest, natural fingers and knuckles. On the black cotton T-shirt, in sharp focus, the printed white walking-figure icon with yellow swoosh and the words WALK FOR EDUCATION sit in the reference arrangement, with the PCI, Rotary and UCU marks above. Fine road dust on the fabric, a few honest sweat specks, tactile cotton weave and nylon texture. Soft golden bokeh of a red-earth road and green hillside. Subject in the right half; the left half warm, low-detail bokeh reserved for a website headline. No watch logos, extra text, watermark or UI.

Premium photorealistic documentary campaign portrait, 70 mm lens at f/2.2, golden hour. Medium waist-up shot of Shyaka walking toward the camera along a dry red-earth village road lined with tall eucalyptus, in a relaxed mid-step, a quiet warm half-smile, eyes just past the lens. Low sun behind and to his left rims his locs, beard and headwrap with gold light while his face stays naturally lit by soft reflected light, with real skin texture and no beauty smoothing. Black campaign T-shirt with the printed front as in the reference, both backpack straps visible over his shoulders. His head is normal adult size in proportion to broad shoulders and chest; do not enlarge the face. The figure occupies the right third of the frame; the left two thirds is soft warm bokeh of the road, eucalyptus trunks and distant hills, very low detail, reserved for a website headline. Believable lens perspective, coherent sun direction, light dust in the air, genuine contact shadows, no HDR, no heavy vignette. No signs, road names, extra people, text overlays, watermark or UI.

review_notes.N1: Both candidates: headwrap, beard, locs, bag layout and eyelets accurate. Tiny UCU wording and the small tag on candidate B are generated, slightly garbled text. A has the cleaner print; B has more atmosphere.
review_notes.N3: Shirt print arrangement matches the real shirt. Candidate B is the closer face likeness but adds a Uganda flag patch to the shirt (bag-only item) and a wristwatch; candidate A is cleaner on the shirt but its face reads lighter and less like the portrait. Both show the printed 1,300 km | 1,650,000 Steps text from the original artwork: do not present it as verified distance (see guide 06). Preamble was tightened afterwards to forbid the shirt flag patch.
review_notes.general: Faces are AI likenesses built from one portrait. The owner should confirm likeness before any public use. Not wired into any page, manifest or gallery.
